actorId.description: Exact stored actorId (e.g. "key:<id>"; not a userId).

asOf.description: Past ISO 8601 instant: memory as it was then (later-superseded facts return as 'superseded').

includeGraph.description: Also list each hit's relations and group co-member ids (not added as hits). Default false.

kinds.description: Default: fact, decision, strategy, workflow, skill, episode, entities. task, event, reasoning only if listed.

minSimilarity.description: Min raw cosine (0 to 1) for semantic hits; lexical-only hits stay eligible.

projection.description: Default `compact`: 300 chars per hit, `truncated: true` when cut (full text: memory_fact). `full`: everything.

query.description: What to recall, free text (e.g. 'client email preferences').

requestId.description: Optional id to correlate a deliberate retry.

scope.description: Omit for all scopes; 'personal' = personal-workspace facts.

scopeRef.description: Filter by project; also matches a kind='project' entity's aliases.

sessionId.description: Active session id; marks lastRecallAt (see memory_session). Unknown ids are ignored.

vectorWeight.description: Deprecated: use mode. 0 = lexical, 1 = vector. Default 0.5.
